name: Clockwork Amulet

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Steady Tick
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): your next attack roll is a 10 on the d20 instead of a roll.

summary: Once a day, take a 10 on an attack roll's d20 instead of rolling.
text: A copper amulet packed with tiny meshing gears, driven by the orderly magic of Mechanus; press an ear to it and you hear soft ticking and whirring. Once per dawn, the wearer can skip rolling the d20 for an attack roll and simply take a 10 on the die.
